1671-2921-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

1308-2757-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two creature tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic land
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1594-4399-4476-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Answered Prayers trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4476-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1008-1619-4605-5231-5542.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1008-1619-4605-5231-5542.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Undermountain Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Undermountain Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1008-1619-4605-5231-5542.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2334-3617-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Soulherder.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-3033-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
997-3033-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

891-6798-7424.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4478-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3000-3899-5223.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4094-4221-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4094-4221-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

3197-6719-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6719-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2275-4067-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
2275-4067-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, putting a counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

586-1363-1636.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature,
586-1363-1636.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {2}{B}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Priest of Gix and one other creature you control, returning Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
586-1363-1636.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1878-2634-4668-5195.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
1878-2634-4668-5195.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
1878-2634-4668-5195.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired. The amount of mana needed to start can be reduced if opponents have drawn cards this turn due to Heliod.

1018-4002-4067-6281.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1018-4002-4067-6281.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Skullwinder.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Skullwinder that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

11-4615-5195-6526.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{W} plus enough mana to cast the spell that creates a token copy
11-4615-5195-6526.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Quasiduplicate, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Quasiduplicate, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Quasiduplicate
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Quasiduplicate.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Quasiduplicate to your hand and creating a copy of Quasiduplicate targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Quasiduplicate copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Quasiduplicate.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a level counter on it

1029-5028-5832.description:
Activate Joraga Treespeaker by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Joraga Treespeaker.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-5832.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

1445-3542-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
1445-3542-6281.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Palinchron, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a token copy of Palinchron that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, targeting Palinchron.
Hashaton triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

560-3394-4550-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
You have at least two cards in hand.
560-3394-4550-5256.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Weatherlight Compleated triggers twice, putting two phyresis counters on it and causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Repeat.

1806-2034-2382-5997.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Alien Warrior and Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

618-5256-5887.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2097-2429-3193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
2097-2429-3193.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1744-2002-2836-3994.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two other Golems on the battlefield.
1744-2002-2836-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Cloak of Feathers by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Cloak of Feathers targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Cloak of Feathers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 8 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

717-4035-4067-4875.description:
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Blood Speaker.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token that enters the battlefield as a Demon due to Conspiracy.
Blood Speaker's second ability triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping target artifact, land or creature.
Repeat.

841-2438-4488-4544.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2438-4488-4544.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Rampaging Baloths.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Beast token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Beast, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

4417-4437.manaNeeded: {B/P}, plus an additional {1} available for each omen counter on Celestial Convergence beyond the first
4417-4437.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
4417-4437.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Celestial Convergence triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {B/P} plus {1} for each omen counter on Celestial Convergence beyond the first, removing all but one omen counter from Celestial Convergence.
Resolve the Celestial Convergence trigger, removing an omen counter from it and causing you to win the game.

2122-2275-4017-4435.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Mindless Automaton.
You have a way to draw a card except the first card you draw during your draw step.
2122-2275-4017-4435.description:
Draw a card, instead causing you to draw two cards due to Alhammarret's Archive.
Shabraz triggers twice.
Resolve a Shabraz trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to gain two life.
Mindless Automaton triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper and Emry do not have summoning sickness.
1329-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emry by tapping them, allowing you to cast Coretapper from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

280-774-4826.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm triggers, targeting itself.
With the trigger on the stack, tap Golgari Rot Farm for {B}{G}.
Allow the trigger to resolve, returning Golgari Rot Farm to your hand.
Repeat.

2290-4017.easyPrerequisites: Spike Feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2290-4017.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's last ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, gaining 2 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Repeat.

936-5069.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{B} plus an additional {2}{U}{B} for each opponent you have
936-5069.notablePrerequisites: Each opponent has a life total that is less than or equal to their library size.
936-5069.description:
Activate Duskmantle Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{U}{B}, causing your opponent to lose life whenever a card is put into their graveyard this turn.
Activate Duskmantle Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{B}, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Duskmantle Guildmage triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to lose 1 life.
Mindcrank triggers, causing the opponent to mill a card.
Duskmantle Guildmage triggers, causing the opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 5 until the opponent has a life total of zero, causing them to lose the game.
Repeat from step 2 for each other opponent.
